fullText.simplified:
第二章、他就是姜维

    时间回到三十六年前。
    公元228年，中国西北方的天水城，诸葛亮的大军围在城外。这是刘备死后的五年里，诸葛亮第一次出兵攻打北方。诸葛亮的目标是被魏国占据的北方旧都，那儿是大汉朝原来的都城。他要收复那座城市，他要让国家统一，他要让大汉朝回到原来辉煌时的样子，这也是刘备死前的愿望。
    诸葛亮为战争做了很多准备，所以一路非常顺利，一个月内拿下了好几座城。直到来到天水，他的大将军赵云第一次遇到了麻烦。
    “丞相，您的计策被人识破了，我们败了！”赵云叹气说。
    “谁识破了我的计策？天水城的太守马真吗？”诸葛亮问。
    “不是马真，是他下面的一个守将，名字叫姜维，看上去很年轻。”赵云苦笑道，“这小小的守将不但聪明，功夫还不错，我和他打了很久都没有打败他。”
    “姜维……”诸葛亮想着什么，没有说话。
    “丞相，接下来我们应该怎么做？”赵云问。
    “速战速决。天水城里的魏军人数不多，明天我亲自带兵强攻，一鼓作气拿下天水！”
    第二天，诸葛亮带着五千大军来到天水城下，城内太守马真带兵守卫。战鼓声响起，攻城战开始。但刚打了一会儿，诸葛亮就听到身后传来喊杀声，城门外不远处的树林里冲出一支军队。这支军队是敌军，人数不多，但都骑着高头大马，个个勇敢强大。最前面的那个人非常年轻，骑白马举长刀，高喊：“诸葛亮中了我的计了！大家一起上，抓住他！”
    诸葛亮立刻明白这是魏军的计谋，想要里外同时进攻打败自己。他远远地看着喊话的这个人，心里赞叹了一声，真是智勇双全！他问赵云：“那个人是谁？”
    “他就是姜维！”赵云大声答道，然后迎着那支军队冲了过去。
    士兵们也立刻转身跟着赵云迎敌，但这时天水城里的太守马真带人从城里冲了出来，他也高喊：“抓住诸葛亮！”两面受敌，诸葛亮的军队一下子就乱了。诸葛亮不敢久战，立刻下令退兵。幸好赵云本领高强，成功保护诸葛亮回到了营地，不然诸葛亮今天可就危险了。
    “会用兵，有智谋，还勇敢，这个姜维，真不错！”诸葛亮赞叹道。
    赵云苦笑道：“丞相，您差点儿被他抓住，难道不害怕吗？”
    诸葛亮微笑摇头，说：“你去查一查姜维的情况，然后我再想拿下天水城的办法。”
fullText.traditional:
第二章、他就是姜維

    時間回到三十六年前。
    公元228年，中國西北方的天水城，諸葛亮的大軍圍在城外。這是劉備死後的五年裡，諸葛亮第一次出兵攻打北方。諸葛亮的目標是被魏國佔據的北方舊都，那兒是大漢朝原來的都城。他要收復那座城市，他要讓國家統一，他要讓大漢朝回到原來輝煌時的樣子，這也是劉備死前的願望。
    諸葛亮為戰爭做了很多準備，所以一路非常順利，一個月內拿下了好幾座城。直到來到天水，他的大將軍趙雲第一次遇到了麻煩。
    “丞相，您的計策被人識破了，我們敗了！”趙雲嘆氣說。
    “誰識破了我的計策？天水城的太守馬真嗎？”諸葛亮問。
    “不是馬真，是他下面的一個守將，名字叫姜維，看上去很年輕。”趙雲苦笑道，“這小小的守將不但聰明，功夫還不錯，我和他打了很久都沒有打敗他。”
    “姜維……”諸葛亮想著什麼，沒有說話。
    “丞相，接下來我們應該怎麼做？”趙雲問。
    “速戰速決。天水城裡的魏軍人數不多，明天我親自帶兵強攻，一鼓作氣拿下天水！”
    第二天，諸葛亮帶著五千大軍來到天水城下，城內太守馬真帶兵守衛。戰鼓聲響起，攻城戰開始。但剛打了一會兒，諸葛亮就聽到身後傳來喊殺聲，城門外不遠處的樹林裡衝出一支軍隊。這支軍隊是敵軍，人數不多，但都騎著高頭大馬，個個勇敢強大。最前面的那個人非常年輕，騎白馬舉長刀，高喊：“諸葛亮中了我的計了！大家一起上，抓住他！”
    諸葛亮立刻明白這是魏軍的計謀，想要裡外同時進攻打敗自己。他遠遠地看著喊話的這個人，心裡讚嘆了一聲，真是智勇雙全！他問趙雲：“那個人是誰？”
    “他就是姜維！”趙雲大聲答道，然後迎著那支軍隊衝了過去。
    士兵們也立刻轉身跟著趙雲迎敵，但這時天水城裡的太守馬真帶人從城裡衝了出來，他也高喊：“抓住諸葛亮！”兩面受敵，諸葛亮的軍隊一下子就亂了。諸葛亮不敢久戰，立刻下令退兵。幸好趙雲本領高強，成功保護諸葛亮回到了營地，不然諸葛亮今天可就危險了。
    “會用兵，有智謀，還勇敢，這個姜維，真不錯！”諸葛亮讚嘆道。
    趙雲苦笑道：“丞相，您差點兒被他抓住，難道不害怕嗎？”
    諸葛亮微笑搖頭，說：“你去查一查姜維的情況，然後我再想拿下天水城的辦法。”

sentences.pinyin: liǎng miàn shòu dí zhū gě liàng de jūn duì yí xià zi jiù luàn le
sentences.english: Facing attacks from both sides, Zhuge Liang’s army quickly fell into disarray.

sentences.simplified: 诸葛亮不敢久战，立刻下令退兵。
sentences.traditional: 諸葛亮不敢久戰，立刻下令退兵。
sentences.pinyin: zhū gě liàng bù gǎn jiǔ zhàn lì kè xià lìng tuì bīng
sentences.english: Zhuge Liang, unwilling to engage in a prolonged battle, immediately ordered a retreat.

sentences.simplified: 幸好赵云本领高强，成功保护诸葛亮回到了营地，
sentences.traditional: 幸好趙雲本領高強，成功保護諸葛亮回到了營地，
sentences.pinyin: xìng hǎo zhào yún běn lǐng gāo qiáng chéng gōng bǎo hù zhū gě liàng huí dào le yíng dì
sentences.english: Fortunately, Zhao Yun, with his exceptional skills, successfully protected Zhuge Liang and brought him back to the camp.

sentences.simplified: 不然诸葛亮今天可就危险了。
sentences.traditional: 不然諸葛亮今天可就危險了。
sentences.pinyin: bù rán zhū gě liàng jīn tiān kě jiù wēi xiǎn le
sentences.english: Otherwise, Zhuge Liang would have been in danger on that day.

sentences.simplified: “会用兵，有智谋，还勇敢，这个姜维，真不错！”诸葛亮赞叹道。
sentences.traditional: “會用兵，有智謀，還勇敢，這個姜維，真不錯！”諸葛亮讚嘆道。
sentences.pinyin: huì yòng bīng yǒu zhì móu hái yǒng gǎn zhè ge jiāng wéi zhēn bú cuò zhū gě liàng zàn tàn dào
sentences.english: “Skilled in warfare, intelligent, and brave—this Jiang Wei is truly impressive!” Zhuge Liang exclaimed in admiration.

sentences.simplified: 赵云苦笑道：“丞相，您差点儿被他抓住，难道不害怕吗？”
sentences.traditional: 趙雲苦笑道：“丞相，您差點兒被他抓住，難道不害怕嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: zhào yún kǔ xiào dào chéng xiàng nín chà diǎn'r bèi tā zhuā zhù nán dào bú hài pà ma
sentences.english: Zhao Yun said with a wry smile, “Chancellor, you were nearly captured by him. Weren’t you afraid?”

sentences.simplified: 诸葛亮微笑摇头，说：
sentences.traditional: 諸葛亮微笑搖頭，說：
sentences.pinyin: zhū gě liàng wēi xiào yáo tóu shuō
sentences.english: Zhuge Liang shook his head with a smile, saying, ..

sentences.simplified: “你去查一查姜维的情况，然后我再想拿下天水城的办法。”
sentences.traditional: “你去查一查姜維的情況，然後我再想拿下天水城的辦法。”
sentences.pinyin: nǐ qù chá yì chá jiāng wéi de qíng kuàng rán hòu wǒ zài xiǎng ná xià tiān shuǐ chéng de bàn fǎ
sentences.english: .. “Go and investigate Jiang Wei’s situation, and then I’ll think of a way to capture Tianshui.”

sentence_translations: Chapter 2: He Is Jiang Wei
We go back to thirty-six years previously.
In the year 228 AD, Zhuge Liang’s large army surrounded the city of Tianshui in northwest China.
This was the first time Zhuge Liang had sent his troops to attack the north in the five years since Liu Bei’s death.
Zhuge Liang’s target was the former northern capital occupied by the state of Wei, which was the original capital of the great Han Dynasty.
He wanted to recapture that city, unify the country, and restore the great Han Dynasty to its former glory.
This was also Liu Bei’s wish before his death.
Zhuge Liang made many preparations for the war, so everything went very smoothly. He captured several cities within a month.
It was not until he arrived in Tianshui that his great general, Zhao Yun, encountered trouble for the first time.
“Chancellor, they saw through your plan, and we have been defeated!” Zhao Yun said with a sigh.
“Who saw through my plan? Was it Ma Zhen, the governor of Tianshui?” Zhuge Liang asked.
“It wasn’t Ma Zhen. It was one of his garrison commanders named Jiang Wei. He looks quite young.”
Zhao Yun said with a wry smile, “This minor garrison commander is not only intelligent but also quite skilled in martial arts.
I fought with him for a long time but still couldn’t defeat him.”
“Jiang Wei …” Zhuge Liang was lost in thought and didn’t say anything.
“Chancellor, what should we do next?” Zhao Yun asked.
“Achieve a quick victory. Wei does not have many troops in Tianshui.
Tomorrow, I will personally lead the troops to storm the city and take Tianshui in one fell swoop!”
The next day, Zhuge Liang led an army of five thousand troops to the gates of Tianshui, ..
.. where the governor Ma Zhen was defending the city with his troops.
The sound of war drums echoed as the assault on the city began.
But shortly after the assault began, Zhuge Liang heard battle cries coming from behind him.
A troop of soldiers emerged from the woods not far from the city gates.
This was a troop of enemy soldiers.
They were not large in number, but each was mounted on a tall horse, and they were all brave and formidable.
The person at the front was very young, riding a white horse and brandishing a long sword, shouting, ..
.. “Zhuge Liang has fallen into my trap! Everyone, charge together and capture him!”
Zhuge Liang immediately understood that this was a plot of the Wei army, ..
.. aiming to attack from both inside and outside simultaneously to defeat him.
He looked at the person shouting from a distance, full of admiration. Truly a combination of wisdom and courage!
He asked Zhao Yun, “Who is that person?”
“He is Jiang Wei!” Zhao Yun responded loudly, then charged toward the troop of soldiers.
His soldiers immediately turned around to follow Zhao Yun and confront the enemy.
But at that moment, the governor of Tianshui, Ma Zhen, led his men to charge out of the city.
He also shouted, “Catch Zhuge Liang!”
Facing attacks from both sides, Zhuge Liang’s army quickly fell into disarray.
Zhuge Liang, unwilling to engage in a prolonged battle, immediately ordered a retreat.
Fortunately, Zhao Yun, with his exceptional skills, successfully protected Zhuge Liang and brought him back to the camp.
Otherwise, Zhuge Liang would have been in danger on that day.
“Skilled in warfare, intelligent, and brave—this Jiang Wei is truly impressive!” Zhuge Liang exclaimed in admiration.
Zhao Yun said with a wry smile, “Chancellor, you were nearly captured by him. Weren’t you afraid?”
Zhuge Liang shook his head with a smile, saying, ..
.. “Go and investigate Jiang Wei’s situation, and then I’ll think of a way to capture Tianshui.”
